The '''Heavy-Lift Starcrosser''' was a model of ore [[Transport/Legends|transport]] that was used by the [[Daimanate]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[New Sith Wars]]. In [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]], a team of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] led by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Vannar Treece]] stole a Starcrosser from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Oranessan]], as part of [[Operation Influx]].
